propositions: review_interrupts metric lacks a reason dimension, preventing CloudWatch-only sweeps from distinguishing bound-exceeded (deploy drain working) from signal-unavailable (health probe broken).
observability.sh must split the journal marker into two separate dimensionless metrics by reason instead of adding a dimension, to avoid silent dimension mismatch with monitoring_autodeploy.tf.

Two new reason-scoped alarms (bound-exceeded and signal-unavailable) must replace the single review_interrupts alarm, each with its own remediation; the rolled-up metric remains published but unalarmed to prevent double-paging.
signal-unavailable alarm must retain single-datapoint sensitivity (evaluation_periods=1, datapoints_to_alarm=1) to catch deploy-blind cases promptly.
The split is proven by automated test driving real observability.sh over a synthetic journal including the four bound-exceeded firings that previously required SSM shell access to diagnose.
terraform apply in infra/terraform was required as operator action to deploy the monitoring contract change; the host-side metric publishing is automatic on observability.sh update.
